text:
Iko Mba Ụwa FIFA nke 2018, nke e mere na Russia site na 14 June ruo 15 July, bụ mbipụta mbụ e mere na Russia nakwa nke mbụ e mere na Eastern Europe. Ndị otu iri atọ na abụọ ka e kewara n’ime otu asatọ nke anọ ọ bụla, ebe ọkwa otu na-eduga n’usoro knockout nke otu nke 16, nkeji iri na ise, ọkara ikpeazụ, egwuregwu nke atọ na nke ikpeazụ, nke 64 egwuregwu n’ozuzu. Ọ bụkwa Iko Mba Ụwa mbụ iji tinye usoro Video Assistant Referee, ma ọ bụ VAR, na-egosi mgbanwe teknụzụ maka asọmpi ahụ. Ihe karịrị nde mmadụ 3 gara n’ofe egwuregwu 64 ahụ, nkezi nke ihe dị ka 47,000 kwa egwuregwu.

Ọkwa otu wetara ihe ijuanya mbụ mgbe Germany, onye nwere aha, ka e wepụrụ, nke bụ ọpụpụ mbụ ya na Iko Mba Ụwa kemgbe 1938. Akụkọ kachasị mkpa nke ọkwa knockout bụ nke Croatia, obere mba ahụ ruru nke mbụ ya na ikpeazụ Iko Mba Ụwa n’usoro nke onye ọkpọ ụgbọ ala Luka Modrić kwadoro. France gara izute ha na Luzhniki Stadium nke Moscow na 15 July.

Na ikpeazụ, France meriri Croatia 4–2 iji nweta aha Iko Mba Ụwa nke abụọ ya, mgbe 1998 gasịrị, na-ahapụ Croatia dị ka onye nke abụọ na mpụta ikpeazụ mbụ ya. Otu n’ime ndị France gbara goolu bụ Kylian Mbappé, onye dị afọ 19 ghọrọ onye ntorobịa mbụ gbara goolu na ikpeazụ Iko Mba Ụwa kemgbe Pelé na 1958 ma kpọọ ya Best Young Player. Mmeri ahụ pụtakwara na France ghọrọ mba Europe nke anọ dị iche iche gbatịpụrụ usoro mmeri Iko Mba Ụwa anọ nke kọntinent ahụ, na-eso ndị mmeri Europe nke 2006, 2010 na 2014.

Nsọpụrụ onye ọ bụla kesara n’ọtụtụ ebe. Harry Kane nke England mechara dị ka onye gbara goolu kacha elu na goolu isii, ebe Luka Modrić nwetara Golden Ball dị ka onye ọkpụkpọ kacha mma nke asọmpi ahụ. Na egwuregwu nke atọ, Belgium meriri England iji nweta ọnọdụ nke atọ, ebe onye nche goolu Belgium Thibaut Courtois nwetara Golden Glove.
